title: Bacterial plasmid: role

doesNotKnow: The role of the named bacterial feature.

misconception: All bacteria have the same structures.
objective: Connect a bacterial structure with one role.

claims.text: Which role is associated with a bacterial plasmid? Plasmid: Is an extra-chromosomal DNA molecule found in many bacteria. This is a model; bacterial structures vary among species.
This model shows selected structures; their presence and arrangements differ among bacteria.
